name: Harhas
title: Grandfather of the prophetess Huldah's husband
summary: Harhas is a biblical figure known as the grandfather of Shallum, the husband of the prophetess Huldah. He is mentioned in connection with King Josiah's reforms when the Book of the Law was found in the temple. His significance lies primarily in his family relationship to Huldah, who played a crucial role in Judah's religious renewal.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in connection with the finding of the Book of the Law
keyEvents.description: When the Book of the Law was found in the temple during King Josiah's reign, the prophetess Huldah was consulted. Huldah was married to Shallum, son of Tikvah, son of Harhas, who was in charge of the garments.

keyEvents.title: Parallel account in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Harhas is also mentioned in 2 Chronicles in the parallel account of the finding of the Book of the Law, where he is called Hasrah. His grandson Shallum was married to the prophetess Huldah.

keyEvents.title: Huldah's prophecy of judgment against Judah
keyEvents.description: Through Huldah's prophetic message, given by virtue of her role as a prophetess in the family connected to Harhas, King Josiah was warned of God's coming judgment on Judah because of idolatry.

keyEvents.title: Huldah's prophecy of grace for Josiah
keyEvents.description: Huldah, who belonged to the family of Harhas, also delivered a message of grace personally to King Josiah because he had humbled himself before the Lord.
